articles.title: Wing and Walmart to expand ‘largest drone delivery network’ in the US
articles.summary: Wing and Walmart are expanding their drone delivery service to Denver and Seattle metros in 2027, bringing fast, reliable and convenient home delivery of thousands of Walmart items to nearly 20 major US metros.

articles.title: RoboStacker: describe your robot, get a ROS 2 stack and a workspace to build (feedback welcome)
articles.summary: Hi everyone, I’ve been building RoboStacker ( https://robostacker.app ), a free tool that helps you plan the software for a ROS 2 robot, and I’d love to hear from people at every level, from a first robot to a production fleet.
